## Features
- Added filter to hide unreleased items from catalogs and search results
- Movies require 30 days after theatrical release before appearing
- TV shows have no buffer (immediate availability)
- Filter can be toggled in plugin settings

## Configuration
Go to Dashboard → Plugins → Gelato → Settings and enable/disable 'Filter unreleased items' checkbox.
